clue.text: Stupid turning over black wet soil

indicators.note: turning over flips the word for wet soil so it reads from the back

parts.note: mud is wet soil
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A gardener calls it stupid to dig over soil that is black and sodden.
explanation.definitionFit: Dumb is an informal synonym for stupid or slow-witted.

clue.text: Curtailed bid to trap deer out of view

indicators.note: to trap means the shortened bid closes around the deer word
curtailed means cut short, so the word for bid loses its final letter

parts.note: an offer is a bid
a stag is a male deer

explanation.surface: A cut-down bid is designed to ensnare a deer that cannot be seen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Curtailed' docks the bid's tail, leaving OFFE, and 'to trap' means the deer goes inside those four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre term: what happens offstage takes place out of the audience's sight, in the wings.

clue.text: Be only partially successful in looking attractive

definitions.meaning: to ... (and lose some) is to succeed only in part

explanation.surface: Someone manages only partial success at looking good.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words, WIN SOME is the first sense; as one word it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Winsome describes a charming, engaging appearance or manner, so it means appealing to look at.

clue.text: Gather old woman's blocking a school's opening

indicators.note: blocking means the mother's word sits in the middle, obstructing the other letters
the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: old woman is slang for mother, MA, so old woman's gives MA'S

explanation.surface: A mother stands in the way of a school's grand opening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening' takes S from 'school's'; 'blocking' puts MAS between A and S.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is to gather or accumulate a large quantity of something.

clue.text: Disorder is nothing with Charles around

indicators.note: around means the short form of Charles goes about the zero

parts.note: Chas is the standard short form of the name Charles
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Things fall apart whenever Charles is absent.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaos is complete confusion, a total lack of order.

clue.text: Group of twelve things, one dozen recalled by Bill

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so the one-and-dozen letters run in reverse

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
doz is the abbreviation for dozen
a bill is an account, abbreviated AC

explanation.surface: Bill lists a set of twelve items and remembers one dozen of them.
explanation.definitionFit: The zodiac is the set of twelve astrological signs, a group of twelve.

clue.text: Railway employee adapted to steam-trains

indicators.note: adapted means altered, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A railway worker has adjusted to working on steam engines.
explanation.definitionFit: A stationmaster is the official in charge of a railway station, a railway worker.

clue.text: Conclude what to do with parcel

definitions.meaning: to bring something to an end
a parcel is enclosed in paper, covered completely

explanation.surface: Finish off by asking how a package should be handled.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrap up is idiomatic for finishing a meeting or task, and literally to enclose a package.

clue.text: Runs into holiday site exhibiting muscle pain

indicators.note: into means the runs letter goes inside the holiday site

parts.note: a camp is a place for a holiday, such as a holiday camp
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A jogger dashes into a holiday camp suffering a muscle ache.
explanation.definitionFit: A cramp is a painful involuntary contraction of a muscle.

clue.text: Source of wool a lot of shops rejected

indicators.note: rejected is read as thrown back, so the words run backwards

parts.note: a mall is a shopping centre, many shops together

explanation.surface: Many shops turned down a supply of wool.
explanation.definitionFit: The llama is a South American animal kept for its woolly fleece.

clue.text: Reporter's claim to look good

definitions.meaning: a journalist might say '...', announcing they work for a newspaper
to make a favourable impression on others

explanation.surface: A journalist insists they are trying to look smart.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as I'M PRESS, it is what a journalist says to get in.
explanation.definitionFit: To impress is to win admiration, so to come across well to someone.

clue.text: College and school subject mostly for brainy type

parts.note: poly is short for polytechnic, a type of college

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: maths is the British name for mathematics, a school subject

explanation.surface: A college and a school subject are largely suited to the clever.
explanation.definitionFit: A polymath is a person of wide learning in many fields, a highly intelligent sort.

clue.text: Force everybody to stumble

parts.note: F is the physics abbreviation for force
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Someone forces every person to trip.
explanation.definitionFit: To fall is to stumble and tumble over, losing balance.

clue.text: Unhappy actors covered by feathers

indicators.note: in a down entry, being covered by means sitting underneath, so the actors come after the feathers

parts.note: down is fine soft feathers
the cast is the set of actors in a show

explanation.surface: Performers smothered in feathers look miserable.
explanation.definitionFit: Downcast means dejected or low-spirited, with eyes lowered in sadness.

clue.text: End up suppressing an example of mental illness

indicators.note: suppressing means the reversed word holds the other one down inside it
in a down entry, up means the word for end is read bottom to top

parts.note: an aim is an end, a goal

explanation.surface: Someone ends up keeping down a case of mental illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'End up' looks like a phrasal verb, but 'End' is a noun meaning goal, and 'up' reverses it to MIA in this down entry; 'suppressing' holds the next word inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Mania is a psychiatric state of abnormal elation and overactivity, one kind of mental disorder.

clue.text: Fingertip zone roughly identifying when ice forms

indicators.note: roughly means approximately arranged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The fingertips are the area that registers roughly when frostbite sets in.
explanation.definitionFit: Water turns solid at zero Celsius, the temperature at which liquid becomes solid.

clue.text: Audibly remained calm

indicators.note: audibly means as heard, so a word that sounds like it is wanted

parts.note: stayed means remained

explanation.surface: Someone stayed composed, saying so out loud.
explanation.definitionFit: Staid means sedate and composed, steady and unexcitable.

clue.text: Determined a soldier should get round blockage

indicators.note: get round means the letters for a soldier surround the blockage

parts.note: a soldier ant is a worker caste, so soldier gives ANT
a dam blocks a river

explanation.surface: A trooper must find a way round an obstruction, resolute as ever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soldier' is not a fighting man here but the soldier caste of ants; 'get round' wraps 'a soldier' around the blockage.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamant means firmly resolved and unyielding, refusing to change one's mind.

clue.text: Presenting no problems, occupying house as yet

indicators.note: occupying means the letters wanted live inside these words

explanation.surface: Living in a property so far has been trouble-free.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy means simple, causing no difficulty.

clue.text: A snooty person picked up one small plant

indicators.note: in a down entry, picked up means lifted, so the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: a snob looks down on others
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A haughty person selects a single tiny plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Bonsai is a tree kept miniature in a pot, a dwarfed shrub.

clue.text: Suggestion to support development of Laos

parts.note: a prop supports something

indicators.note: development of means the country's name is worked into a new form

explanation.surface: An idea to back the economic growth of Laos.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal is a plan or idea put forward for consideration.

clue.text: Beneficiary a man we hear making long-distance communication

indicators.note: we hear means the words are said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: an heir is a beneficiary, and a male is a man

explanation.surface: A male heir is said to be sending a letter overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Airmail is letters carried by plane, the usual post for sending overseas.

clue.text: Do not oppose legislation limiting Church power

indicators.note: limiting means the law word sets bounds on both sides of the other letters

parts.note: an act is a piece of legislation
CE stands for the Church of England
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Avoid opposing a law that curbs the Church's authority.
explanation.definitionFit: To accept is to agree to or go along with, not resisting.

clue.text: Friend leading Mass including second devotional song

indicators.note: leading means the friend comes first, ahead of the mass letter
including means the letters hold another one within them

parts.note: a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A friend leads Mass and adds a holy song.
explanation.definitionFit: A psalm is a sacred song or hymn, especially one from the biblical Book of Psalms.

clue.text: Region to receive new sporting venue

indicators.note: to receive means the region word takes the extra letter inside it

parts.note: an area is a region

explanation.surface: A district is set to get a new stadium.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is an enclosed space for sports or entertainment.

clue.text: Strike starts to seriously limit actual production

indicators.note: starts to means the opening letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: Industrial action begins to cut real output severely.
explanation.definitionFit: To slap is to hit with an open hand.
